title: When AI Investigators Cannot Trust Their Tools: Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification for Cyber Threat Investigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly triage security alerts by combining the outputs of several detection tools, implicitly treating those tools as trustworthy. Unlike prior work on conflicts between a model's knowledge and its context, we study conflicts among the tools themselves: what happens when this machine-generated evidence is conflicting or wrong. On the corrected CIC-IDS2017 dataset, four heterogeneous detectors emit labels and confidences that we corrupt under a threat model varying the number of corrupted tools, the persistence of the corruption, and the confidence attached to wrong outputs. Across open-weight LLMs from 3B to 14B parameters, unverified investigators are fragile: one corrupted detector out of four lowers naive accuracy to .50-.72, three lower every unverified investigator to .13 or less, and honest disagreement alone makes them abstain on up to 63% of flows. translated_title: 当AI调查员无法信任其工具时：面向网络威胁调查的冲突感知证据验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41191v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过组合多个检测工具的输出来对安全警报进行分诊，并隐式地假设这些工具是可信的。与以往研究模型自身知识与上下文之间冲突的工作不同，我们研究的是工具彼此之间的冲突：当这些机器生成的证据相互矛盾或出错时会发生什么。在修正后的CIC-IDS2017数据集上，四个异构检测器输出标签和置信度，我们在一个威胁模型下对这些输出进行污染，该威胁模型改变被污染工具的数量、污染的持续性以及错误输出所附带的置信度。在从3B到14B参数的一系列开源权重LLM中，未经核实的调查者十分脆弱：四个检测器中仅一个被污染就会使朴素准确率降至0.50-0.72，三个被污染则使所有未经核实的调查者准确率降至0.13或更低，而仅仅是检测器之间诚实的分歧就会使它们在多达63%的流量上选择弃权。我们提出了冲突感知证据验证（CAV），它基于……
tldr: 该论文揭示了LLM安全调查智能体在面对被污染或相互冲突的检测工具输出时的脆弱性，并提出冲突感知证据验证（CAV）方法，使智能体能够核实工具证据，从而在多个检测器被污染的情况下显著提升调查的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the fragility of LLM-based cyber threat investigation agents when tool-generated evidence is corrupted or conflicting, and proposes Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification (CAV), enabling agents to verify detector outputs and remain robust even when multiple detection tools are compromised.
